name: Peace Domain
description: A cleric subclass that adds the Peace tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Emboldening Bond
grants.description: As an Action, bond a number of willing creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus for 10 minutes. Once per turn, a bonded creature near another bonded creature can add 1d4 to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

grants.name: Implement of Peace
grants.description: Gain proficiency in Insight, Performance, or Persuasion.

grants.name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
grants.description: As an Action, move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The first time you move within 5 feet of a creature during this movement, you can restore 2d6 plus your Wisdom modifier Hit Points to it.

grants.name: Protective Bond
grants.description: When a bonded creature is about to take damage, another bonded creature within 30 feet can use its Reaction to teleport adjacent and take all of that damage instead.

grants.name: Expansive Bond
grants.description: Your bond's protective teleport works at 60 feet, and a creature that takes damage through Protective Bond has Resistance to that damage.
